title: Event record (Contract B)
description: Produced by component 1, stored and served by component 2, rendered by component 3. Written as JSON Lines to events.jsonl, one object per line, in ascending t_seconds order.

team.description: Null if the track was never identified. Consumers must handle null.

track_id.$comment: OPEN CONTRACT QUESTION -- see OPEN_QUESTIONS.md #1. Doc 0 lists track_id as required and non-nullable, but match_start / match_end / phase_change are not attributable to a track. Encoded as nullable here so the fixture validates; component 3 tolerates null or absent. Needs agreement before this is settled either way.

t_seconds.description: Float seconds, three decimal places, relative to the start of the SEGMENT.

field_x.description: Feet, origin at field center, +x toward the blue alliance wall. Null if homography failed for that frame range.

field_y.description: Feet, origin at field center, +y toward the scoring table side. Null if homography failed for that frame range.
